definitions.gloss: somehow, for some reason, kind of
definitions.explanation: Expresses a vague feeling or impression that one cannot clearly explain. Used when the speaker senses something but cannot pinpoint the reason.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}だか⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧な⟦{予感|よかん}→予感：11416_yokan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have a bad feeling for some reason.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}だか⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Today I just don't feel energetic for some reason.

notes:
{何|なん}だか expresses a vague, hard-to-define feeling. The speaker senses something but cannot clearly explain why. It often carries a slight emotional undertone.

FORMS:
⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (what) + だ (copula) + ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (question particle) — literally "what is it..." used adverbially to convey uncertainty.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何|なん}だか⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: I don't know what it is / I can't tell
- {何|なん}だか⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧: I feel somehow happy
- {何|なん}だか⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧だ: something seems odd

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なんとなく: vaguely, somehow (more neutral, less emotional)
- ⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: for some reason (implies puzzlement, slightly more objective)
- ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: somehow (wider range of uses, more formal)
- ⟦どことなく→どことなく：18218_dokotonaku⟧: in some indefinable way (literary)

REGISTER:
{何|なん}だか is conversational and informal. In writing or formal speech, なんとなく or ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ is preferred.
